disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件中所有涉及密钥与敏感数据的代码路径：API Key 仅在调用 MinerU 服务时，先向宿主凭据服务查询、再回退到环境变量解析，并作为请求头只发送给用户配置的服务器地址（默认本机 18000 端口）；未发现读取本机凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云厂商密钥或钱包资产的行为。
checked_items.en: Examined all code paths in the plugin involving credentials and sensitive data: API Key is first queried from the host credential service, then falls back to environment variable parsing, and is sent as a request header only to the user-configured server address (default localhost port 18000); no behavior of reading local credential files, SSH private keys, cloud vendor keys, or wallet assets was found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了硬编码密钥模式，未发现任何明文密钥、令牌或口令。
checked_items.en: Scanned for hardcoded credential patterns, no plaintext keys, tokens, or passwords were found.

evidence.zh: 核查了凭据读取面：插件未读取 .credentials.yaml、SSH 私钥、云凭据等敏感路径；API Key 仅从宿主凭据服务或环境变量解析，并只发送给用户配置的服务器。
evidence.en: Inspected the credential reading surface: the plugin does not read sensitive paths such as .credentials.yaml, SSH private keys, cloud credentials; API Key is only parsed from the host credential service or environment variables, and sent only to the user-configured server.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 5 个工具对模型可见的说明文本、开发指南与界面文案，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导读取凭据、诱导安装或诱导放开权限的注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Examined all 5 tools' visible description texts, development guide, and UI copy for the model; no injection phrasing was found such as instruction override, system message disguise, induced credential reading, induced installation, or induced permission escalation.

checked_items.zh: 开发指南 AGENTS.md 存在（机器预扫命中 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57）：内容为面向开发者的插件架构与开发说明，不含对模型下达的指令，判定为正常文档。
checked_items.en: The development guide AGENTS.md exists (machine pre-scan hit DSH-X10/DG-R2-57): its content is a developer-oriented plugin architecture and development description, containing no instructions directed at the model; judged as a normal document.

checked_items.zh: 工具说明中出现“若只有 URL 请先下载（如用 curl）”的语句（机器预扫命中 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53）：属于文档解析场景的常规使用指引，不构成注入，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: The tool description contains the phrase "If only URL, please download first (e.g., use curl)" (machine pre-scan hit DSH-C05/DG-R4-53): this is a normal usage guidance for document parsing scenarios, does not constitute injection, judged as benign.

evidence.zh: 逐一审查了 5 个工具对模型可见的说明文本，均为正常用法描述（参数含义、默认值、调用顺序），未发现系统指令或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: Reviewed each of the 5 tools' description texts visible to the model; all are normal usage descriptions (parameter meaning, default values, invocation order), no system instructions or hidden intent was found.

evidence.zh: 工具说明不含诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；“URL 先下载”是文档解析场景的正常指引。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions do not contain phrasing that induces plugin installation, configuration rewriting, or permission escalation; "download URL first" is normal guidance for document parsing scenarios.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与构建产物中的动态执行调用（动态函数构造、求值、子进程、下载即执行等），未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and build artifacts for dynamic execution calls (dynamic function construction, eval, subprocess, download-and-execute, etc.), none detected.

checked_items.zh: 未发现调用动态包工具（让模型把代码塞进宿主运行）的情况。
checked_items.en: No invocation of dynamic package tools (letting the model inject code into the host for execution) was found.

checked_items.zh: 包内没有安装钩子（package.json 仅有类型检查、测试、构建三个开发脚本），也没有版本控制钩子、CI 工作流、容器配置或 Makefile 等可执行载体。
checked_items.en: The package has no install hooks (package.json only has three development scripts: type check, test, build), nor version control hooks, CI workflows, container configurations, or Makefiles as executable carriers.

checked_items.zh: 两个长行命中的文件均为构建产物：客户端 bundle 里内联的样式字符串与源码映射文件（机器预扫命中 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60），属于正常构建输出而非混淆代码，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: The two files hit by long-line scanning are build artifacts: inline style strings in the client bundle and source map files (machine pre-scan hit DSH-X08/DG-R3-60), which are normal build output rather than obfuscated code; judged as benign.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml 仅含插入插件自身配置行，未发现可执行标量（如 !!js），不存在挂载时执行任意代码的面。
evidence.en: The patch file cordis.patch.yml only contains lines inserting the plugin's own configuration, no executable scalars (e.g., !!js) were found, and there is no surface for arbitrary code execution during mounting.

evidence.zh: 插件不包含动态包工具或任何让模型在宿主进程执行代码的能力，该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not include dynamic package tools or any ability to let the model execute code in the host process; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装/准备钩子；树内无版本控制钩子、CI 工作流、容器配置或 Makefile 等执行载体；git 依赖均锁定版本。
evidence.en: package.json has no install/prepare hooks; the tree contains no version control hooks, CI workflows, container configurations, or Makefiles as executable carriers; git dependencies are all pinned to specific versions.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器客户端；已核查客户端 bundle，仅包含设置页组件，通过宿主 RPC 读写自身配置，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取或调用特权凭据接口。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser client; the client bundle has been inspected, containing only settings page components, reading/writing its own configuration via host RPC; no keyboard monitoring, clipboard reading, or privileged credential interface invocation was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件全部网络请求：唯一外联目标是用户配置的 MinerU 服务地址（默认本机 18000 端口），未发现其他外联域名、隧道、回调、云存储转储或编码后外发链。
checked_items.en: Checked all network requests of the plugin: the only outbound target is the user-configured MinerU service address (default localhost port 18000); no other outbound domains, tunnels, callbacks, cloud storage dumps, or encoded exfiltration chains were found.

checked_items.zh: 工具说明中提及 curl 仅为给模型的文字指引，插件自身不执行 curl 或 wget（机器预扫命中 DSH-C05/DG-R4-53，判定为良性）。
checked_items.en: The mention of curl in the tool description is only a textual guidance for the model; the plugin itself does not execute curl or wget (machine pre-scan hit DSH-C05/DG-R4-53, judged as benign).

evidence.zh: 核查了外联通道：唯一网络出口是用户配置的 MinerU 服务地址（默认本机），未发现凭据外泄的编码变换或带外通道；API Key 随请求只发往该地址，并配置了拒绝重定向。
evidence.en: Inspected outbound channels: the only network egress is the user-configured MinerU service address (default localhost); no encoded transformation or out-of-band channels for credential exfiltration were found; API Key is sent only to that address with redirect rejection configured.

checked_items.zh: 检查了补丁文件：仅插入插件自身配置行（含默认服务地址种子），未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，不含可执行标量，未改写服务注入配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch file: only inserts the plugin's own configuration lines (including the default service address seed), does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; contains no executable scalars, and does not rewrite service injection configurations.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单与锁文件：运行时仅依赖 schemastery 一个第三方包（常规配置校验库），其余为宿主提供的 @deepseek-ai/* 系列包；未发现安装钩子、未锁定版本的 git 依赖或疑似仿冒的依赖名。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest and lock file: the only runtime dependency is schemastery (a regular configuration validation library), the rest are @deepseek-ai/* packages provided by the host; no install hooks, unpinned git dependencies, or suspiciously named dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计没有版本基线，无法执行升级自动激活、能力升级与更新漂移的版本比对，该部分判定为不适用。
checked_items.en: First audit, no version baseline; cannot perform version comparison for upgrade auto-activation, capability upgrade, or update drift; this part is judged as not applicable.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，不含禁用或降权配置，不存在覆盖安全配置的面。
evidence.en: The patch file does not touch security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; contains no disable or downgrade configuration; there is no surface for overriding security configurations.

evidence.zh: 全树未发现对安全事件的高优监听（如短路审批链的监听器），审批链截断场景不成立。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners for security events (e.g., listeners that short-circuit the approval chain) were found in the entire tree; the scenario of approval chain truncation does not apply.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法比较清单声明是否突变。
evidence.en: First audit, no version baseline; cannot compare whether the manifest declaration has mutated.

evidence.zh: 补丁文件未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patch file does not rewrite inject/intercept configurations; there is no surface to cause a security plugin to hang by appending mandatory services that do not exist.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅注册宿主已有的本地 RPC 通道供设置页读写自身配置；宿主本地 RPC 无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险，不是本插件引入的问题。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; it only registers the host's existing local RPC channel for the settings page to read/write its own configuration; the host's local RPC without authentication is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem, not a problem introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 本环境没有动态沙箱观测产物，未做动态运行验证，运行时结论基于静态分析。
checked_items.en: This environment has no dynamic sandbox observation artifacts; dynamic runtime verification was not performed; runtime conclusions are based on static analysis.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅复用宿主本地 RPC 通道；本机无认证 RPC 属宿主生态固有风险，非本插件引入，场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port; it only reuses the host's local RPC channel; unauthenticated RPC on localhost is an inherent risk of the host ecosystem, not introduced by this plugin; the scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件身份与清单核对通过：package.json 的 dsh 声明（补丁与客户端入口）与真实文件一致，补丁内容仅为插件自身配置插入，未发现名称仿冒或可疑元数据。
summary.en: Plugin identity and manifest verification passed: the dsh declaration in package.json (patch and client entry points) matches the actual files; the patch content is only the insertion of the plugin's own configuration; no name spoofing or suspicious metadata was found.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：7 条机器预扫命中逐条核查，均为正常工具说明文字或构建产物，未构成漏洞或后门；未检出动态执行、注入措辞、硬编码凭据。
summary.en: Static scan passed: 7 machine pre-scan hits were individually reviewed; all are normal tool description text or build artifacts, not constituting vulnerabilities or backdoors; no dynamic execution, injection phrasing, or hardcoded credentials were detected.

summary.zh: 行为面分析通过：无安装钩子、无可执行载体、无混淆载荷；外联仅限用户配置的 MinerU 服务地址，凭据只按配置发往该地址。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis passed: no install hooks, no executable carriers, no obfuscated payloads; outbound communication is limited to the user-configured MinerU service address; credentials are sent only to that address as configured.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：5 个工具说明与开发指南无注入措辞；能力声明与代码实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: the 5 tool descriptions and development guide contain no injection phrasing; capability declarations are consistent with code implementation.

summary.zh: 本环境未做动态沙箱验证（无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: This environment did not perform dynamic sandbox verification (no dynamic observation artifacts).

limits.zh: 能力声明（network/shell/fs/modelFacing）为从代码推断得出，插件清单未显式声明能力字段；插件未声明 dsh 引擎版本，engines.dsh 与兼容性按 peer 依赖的宿主 SDK 版本（@deepseek-ai/dsh-* ^0.0.1-rc.1）推断且未实测；未做动态沙箱验证；工具按设计读取本地文件并上传至用户配置的解析服务器，属文档解析工具的固有行为；宿主本地 RPC 无认证属 dsh 生态固有风险。
limits.en: Capability declarations (network/shell/fs/modelFacing) are inferred from the code; the plugin manifest does not explicitly declare capability fields; the plugin does not declare the dsh engine version; engines.dsh and compatibility are inferred from the peer dependency host SDK version (@deepseek-ai/dsh-* ^0.0.1-rc.1) and not verified by testing; no dynamic sandbox verification was performed; the tool, by design, reads local files and uploads them to the user-configured parsing server, which is an inherent behavior of a document parsing tool; the host's local RPC without authentication is an inherent risk of the dsh ecosystem.
